island.name: Transport & directions
island.description: Asking the way, using buses, taxis and trains, and dealing with delays.

sentences.en: How do I get to the train station?
Is it far from here?
Go straight and then turn left.
sentences.ro: Mergi drept și apoi fă stânga.
sentences.note: "Fă stânga" (make left) is how drivers and locals say it.

sentences.en: It's about ten minutes on foot.
sentences.ro: E cam zece minute pe jos.

sentences.en: Which bus goes to the centre?
Where can I buy a ticket?
sentences.ro: De unde pot să cumpăr un bilet?

sentences.en: Does this tram stop at the market?
I'm getting off at the next stop.
Sorry, I'm lost.
I don't know this neighbourhood.
Can you show me on the map?
sentences.ro: Poți să îmi arăți pe hartă?

sentences.en: The train is twenty minutes late.
sentences.ro: Trenul are douăzeci de minute întârziere.
sentences.note: Delay uses "a avea": literally "the train has twenty minutes of delay".

sentences.en: I missed my bus.
Please take me to this address.
sentences.ro: Vă rog să mă duceți la adresa asta.
sentences.note: Said to a taxi driver — "vă rog" keeps it polite.

sentences.en: How much is the ride to the airport?
sentences.ro: Cât costă cursa până la aeroport?

sentences.en: Stop here, please.
There's a lot of traffic this morning.
sentences.ro: E mult trafic în dimineața asta.

sentences.en: I don't have change for the ticket.
sentences.note: "Mărunt" = small coins; "rest" is the change you get back.

sentences.en: Where do I have to change trains?
I usually go to work by bike.
sentences.ro: De obicei merg la muncă cu bicicleta.
